svg.title: How SimCruise works
svg.desc: Player input goes to the Godot client, which streams a 3 by 3 ring of map tiles around the car by running the atlas helper, a Bun binary that fetches fifteen public data layers into a 96 MiB cache. WorldTile builds terrain, roads, buildings and trees from each tile; Powertrain drives the Miata on it; the Mobile renderer and procedural audio return picture and sound to the player.
svg.text: Your hands → Godot client → tile grid → atlas helper → public data → WorldTile → Powertrain → your eyes and ears

g.title: Player — Keyboard or Xbox controller in; picture and sound out.
g.text: W A S D · sticks · triggers

g.title: Godot client — Drive.gd owns the scene: tiles, car, camera, HUD, sun and weather, with helper jobs on worker threads.
g.text: owns the scene and worker threads
picks the next tile · builds it
parks the car on the nearest road
waits for the road ahead to exist

g.title: Tile grid — Web Mercator zoom-16 tiles, about 486 m at the Virginia start; a 3 × 3 ring streams around the car and the origin is re-centred every 6 tiles.
Atlas helper — Bun-compiled native binary beside the app; one process per job; one rate-limited fetcher; a 96 MiB least-recently-used cache.
g.text: Bun binary atlas · one process per job

g.title: Public data — Fifteen layers, each fetched only when a job needs it, each with its own licence.
Roads & buildings — OpenStreetMap via OpenFreeMap vector tiles: roads, footprints, land use, water, places. ODbL 1.0.
Place search — Photon geocoder on OpenStreetMap data; US results only; 7-day cache.
Building heights & roofs — Overture buildings archive (heights, roof tags, extra footprints) checked against Esri's OSM replica; the Overture base theme's infrastructure layer for traffic signals.
Lanes & one-way — Esri-hosted OpenStreetMap North America highways replica: lane, one-way and bridge tags for a 2 × 2 tile group, used to drop the inferred centre line on single-lane one-way roads.
Ground elevation — USGS 3DEP 1/3-arc-second DEM blocks and Terrarium tiles for each tile's 65 × 65 height grid; 1 m 3DEP for road banks. US public domain.
Aerial imagery — USGS National Map imagery (1024-px JPEG per 4 × 4 block), USDA NAIP for Hawaii, USFS Alaska orthophotos. Public domain.
Tree canopy — WRI / Meta High Resolution Canopy Height Maps v2, one 512-px block per tile. CC BY 4.0.
Recent colour — Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A via Element 84 Earth Search: recent cloud-masked ground colour and scene class. Optional.
Weather & sky — NOAA METAR observations, the IEM station archive, GOES cloud mask and NASA snow drive sky, fog and lighting. Public domain.
Street photos — KartaView and Panoramax thumbnails sample pavement and verge colour near the capture track. CC BY-SA 4.0, credits kept.
Building use — US Army Corps of Engineers National Structure Inventory: modelled use and storeys for a footprint. Public domain.
City trees — Lincoln NE and Cambridge MA municipal tree inventories move canopy crowns onto recorded trunks. City open-data terms; PDDL 1.0 (Cambridge).
Lidar roofs & camber — USGS 3DEP point clouds (Entwine Point Tiles on AWS) fit roof shapes and road camber where a flight exists; Miami-Dade lidar for 15 bundled roofs.
Forest & shrub cover — LANDFIRE and NLCD stand types, Rangeland Analysis Platform shrub cover, RCMAP shrub height and NAIP low vegetation. Public domain.
Horizon terrain — A display-only relief mesh reaching 45 km: 1,025 × 1,025 Terrarium heights simplified by Martini, draped with National Map imagery, ridge imagery and snow.
WorldTile builder — Turns one tile's JSON into terrain (65 × 65 heights), roads with lane paint and curbs, buildings, trees, grass and a collision trimesh.
g.text: later passes swap roofs and paint

g.title: Powertrain — Jolt rigid body with four raycast suspension corners, slip-angle tyres, 5-speed, clutch and differential, calibrated to the 1999 road-test numbers.
Picture & sound — Mobile renderer on Metal with one sun on the real clock, haze and 180 m shadows; a damped head camera; procedural engine, tyre and wind sound.
g.text: one sun · real clock · 180 m shadows
head camera · HUD levels · one haze
engine at rpm/30 Hz · limiter · pops

svg.text: The interactive page explains every stage and layer: files, sources, licences, limits. Generated from the code by docs/how-it-works/build.py.
